GET TRUE FULLSCREEN

You're in an in-app browser, which forces a small viewport. Follow these steps to play in real fullscreen.
1
Tap the "⋯" menu at the top-right of this window
→ tap "Open in browser" (Safari)
2
In Safari, tap the Share button ↗
→ scroll down → tap "Add to Home Screen"
→ tap Add
3
Launch the new SCOPE 3D icon from your home screen.
It will run as a real fullscreen app — no bars, no browser.
iOS Safari doesn't allow web pages to enter fullscreen directly — Apple only permits it for installed home-screen apps.
